title: 兰博·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 毛茸茸约德尔人戴护目镜，安坐在红黄拼补步行机甲之中。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Rumble is an adult furry yordle with large ears, goggles, and a compact body seated in a patched red-and-yellow walking mech. Preserve the open round cockpit, two massive articulated feet, bolted armor, pipes, and folded tool arms; all projecting machinery is inactive with no discharge or open flames.
art_direction.scene: A composed near-profile study with a gentle head turn, signature forms stacked into a tall diagonal, luminous rim and airy negative space. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: brick red, ochre yellow, iron gray, white light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
